errors.permission: No permission to open the i2c device. Install the udev rule from the README.
errors.no_device: The i2c device does not exist. Load the i2c-dev kernel module (see the README).
errors.unknown_input: Unknown input '{id}'. Use dp, usbc, hdmi1 or hdmi2.
errors.no_monitor: No connected monitor with EDID vendor '{vendor}' found.
errors.no_quick_target: The quick-switch target has no code
errors.no_inputs: No input has a valid code. Check the input codes in the settings.

quick_target.label: Quick-switch target
quick_target.description: Input a left click, the Control Center tile and the 'quick' IPC event switch to. Set it to the other machine's input: USB-C on the workstation, DisplayPort on the laptop.

code.description: Value sent to the monitor for this input, hex (0xD0) or decimal. Empty hides the input. The defaults are for LG monitors in LG mode.

name.description: Name shown in the menu and the bar, for example Workstation or Laptop. Empty uses the input name.

protocol.label: Protocol
protocol.description: LG uses host address 0x50 and VCP 0xF4. Other monitors use standard MCCS Input Select (VCP 0x60) with their own codes.

vendor.label: EDID vendor id
vendor.description: Three-letter manufacturer id used to find the monitor. GSM is LG.

connector.label: Connector
connector.description: Only use the monitor on this connector, for example DP-1. Empty picks the first match.

bus.label: i2c bus override
bus.description: Always use /dev/i2c-N with this number and skip detection. -1 detects automatically.
